answers.p1: Codes are six base-36 characters counted up from zero with no randomness, so tests are deterministic.
answers.p2: In `shortener/routes.py`, in the function `handle(method, path, body, store)`.
answers.p3: Tests call `handle()` directly and never bind a socket, since the CI sandbox refuses ports.
answers.p5: Only http and https URLs can be shortened; other schemes like ftp are rejected.
answers.p7: Hit counters, then JSON persistence, then docs.
